table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	itemname= item.name, 
	PurOrderHeader.POCode,   
	PurOrderHeader.Date,   
	PurOrderDetail.ICode,   
	PurOrderDetail.Qty,  
	PurOrderDetail.Rate,  
	PACKINGDESC=ITEM.packingdesc, 
	Accounts.Name,
	Supplier.Address1, 
	Supplier.Address2,
	PurOrderDetail.PORowID,
	Manufacturer=(select Manufacturer.name from Manufacturer where Manufacturer.manfcode=item.manfcode),
	Total = PurOrderDetail.Qty * PurOrderDetail.Rate,
	PurOrderDetail.remarks,
	PurOrderHeader.remarks,
	PurOrderHeader.PurOrderTerms1,
	PurOrderHeader.PurOrderTerms2,
	PurOrderHeader.SupplierReference,
	PurOrderHeader.DeliveryLocation,
	PurOrderHeader.SaleOrderCode,
	PurOrderHeader.UsageLocation,
	PurOrderHeader.RequiredDate
FROM 
	PurOrderDetail,   
   PurOrderHeader,   
	Accounts, 
	Item,
	Supplier
WHERE 
	( PurOrderHeader.POCode = PurOrderDetail.POCode ) and  
	( PurOrderDetail.icode = item.icode ) and  
	( PurOrderHeader.SuppCode = Supplier.SuppCode ) and  
	( PurOrderHeader.SuppCode = Accounts.AccCode ) and  
	( ( PurOrderHeader.POCode = :ra_POCode ) )
ORDER BY 
	PurOrderDetail.PORowID
